passages.museum:
Date: February 20
Subject: City Museum Membership

Dear Ms. Miller,

As your City Museum annual membership is about to expire, please renew it by March 31 to keep your benefits. This year, members will receive a special exhibition invitation. A 15% discount is available exclusively on our recently released mobile application, so we recommend that you download it to take advantage of this special offer.

Sincerely,
Ava Mitchell
passages.wellness:
Subject: Wellness Workshop Series

Dear Ms. Johnson,

We’re pleased to extend an invitation to our Comprehensive Wellness Workshop Series, taking place from March 12 to 14 at the Grand Convention Center.

This year’s focus is “Nutrition, Fitness, and Mindfulness Integration.” The event will feature a keynote address from esteemed nutritionist Dr. Sarah Williams, alongside four dynamic expert panel discussions and interactive, hands-on sessions. A full schedule will be shared shortly.

We’re also bringing back the popular Participant Showcase, where attendees can share their own healthy recipes or personal fitness routines. If you’d like to be a part of the showcase, please send a brief proposal to the organizing team by February 25.

Warm regards,
Michael Hughes

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the email?

options.label: A
options.text: To announce the renewal of a museum program

options.label: B
options.text: To invite a member to a special event

options.label: C
options.text: To provide a reminder about continuing a museum membership

options.label: D
options.text: To advertise a curator job at the museum

questions.answer: The membership is about to expire, and Ms. Miller is asked to renew it by March 31. 正解：C。展示会の招待は会員特典の一つで、メール全体の目的ではありません。expireは『期限が切れる』、renewは『更新する』です。

questions.prompt: What is Ms. Miller advised to do?

options.label: A
options.text: Take advantage of her benefits

options.label: B
options.text: Install a program on a device

options.label: C
options.text: Visit the museum to see an exhibition

options.label: D
options.text: Submit payment online

questions.answer: The email recommends downloading the museum’s mobile application to receive the special discount. 正解：B。download the applicationは端末へプログラムを導入することです。展示会訪問やオンライン支払いは勧められていません。exclusivelyは『限定で』です。

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the email?

options.label: A

options.label: B
options.text: To provide a schedule of upcoming wellness events

options.label: C
options.text: To collect feedback from past participants

options.label: D

questions.answer: The opening sentence explicitly extends an invitation to the Comprehensive Wellness Workshop Series. 正解：A。日程の詳細は後日共有されるためBではなく、感想募集や受賞者発表もありません。extend an invitationは『招待する』です。

options.label: A
options.text: moderate panel discussions

options.label: B
options.text: teach hands-on workshops

options.label: C
options.text: deliver the main presentation on wellness

options.label: D

questions.answer: Dr. Williams will give the keynote address, the event’s principal presentation. 正解：C。panel discussionsとhands-on sessionsは併催内容ですが、彼女が司会・指導するとは書かれていません。keynote addressは『基調講演』です。

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about the Participant Showcase sessions?

options.label: A
options.text: They will be held on February 25.

options.label: B
options.text: They are exclusively for nutrition experts.

options.label: C
options.text: They require payment of an additional fee.

options.label: D

questions.answer: The phrase “bringing back” shows that the Participant Showcase was offered before. 正解：D。February 25は提案の提出期限で、開催日ではありません。参加者がレシピや運動法を共有でき、専門家限定や追加料金の記載もありません。
